notes_for_editor: The register and the Forest Fire Lookout Association both give platform and gone, and the record's FFLOS US 1705 and coordinates match. The discovery account comes from one hobbyist page (WillhiteWeb) that describes the site as apparently unrecorded and gives no visit date beyond mid-October; its captions cite the Lookout Network Winter 2010 issue. The register does not say when the site was first found. The Forest Fire Lookout Association index shows FFLOS US 2026 next to High Rock (Pend Oreille), not Horseshoe, so no correction is proposed. No access or current-visit information was found.
